description: All balance and simulation tunables for Module 03 (Tech Tree, Research Progress, IRAD vs Government Contracts, NACA Diffusion, and Maturity).

tunables_meta.name: eng_efficiency_per_day
tunables_meta.effect: Base engineer-days of progress generated per effective engineer per calendar day.
tunables_meta.rationale: 1.0 means 10 engineers on a 1,800 eng-day node finish in ~180 days at 1.0x speed.

tunables_meta.name: max_effective_engineers_per_project
tunables_meta.effect: Hard cap on effective engineer-equivalents that can contribute to a single tech node.
tunables_meta.rationale: Brooks's Law: piling 200 engineers onto one research question cannot finish it in a week.

tunables_meta.name: diminishing_returns_threshold_eng
tunables_meta.effect: Number of assigned engineers before Brooks's Law diminishing returns kick in.
tunables_meta.rationale: Small Skunk-Works-sized research teams (10-15 engineers) work at 100% marginal efficiency.

tunables_meta.name: diminishing_returns_exponent
tunables_meta.effect: Power-law exponent applied to engineers assigned above diminishing_returns_threshold_eng.
tunables_meta.rationale: Encourages parallelizing across 2-3 tech branches rather than doom-stacking one node.

tunables_meta.name: aot_free_lead_years
tunables_meta.effect: Years ahead of historical_year with zero ahead-of-time research penalty.
tunables_meta.rationale: Allows slight historical divergence (6 months early) without punitive slowdowns.

tunables_meta.name: aot_rate_per_year
tunables_meta.effect: Denominator growth coefficient per year ahead of (historical_year - aot_free_lead_years).
tunables_meta.rationale: Prevents rushing 1956 Mach 2 techs in 1948 while allowing a focused company to lead by 1-2 years at steep cost.

tunables_meta.name: aot_exponent
tunables_meta.effect: Non-linear exponent on ahead-of-time years excess.
tunables_meta.rationale: 1 yr early = 0.72x speed; 3 yrs early = 0.31x speed; 5 yrs early hits floor (0.12x).

tunables_meta.name: aot_min_speed_multiplier
tunables_meta.effect: Floor on ahead-of-time speed multiplier.
tunables_meta.rationale: Avoids division-by-zero or complete stall while making 5+ year rushes impractical.

tunables_meta.name: catchup_rate_per_year
tunables_meta.effect: Linear research speed bonus per year after a node's historical_year.
tunables_meta.rationale: Published papers, trade journals, and engineer mobility make late research faster.

tunables_meta.name: catchup_max_speed_multiplier
tunables_meta.effect: Maximum speed multiplier from behind-time catchup.
tunables_meta.rationale: Caps catch-up at +75% speed (reached 3.75 years after historical date).

tunables_meta.name: irad_company_cost_share
tunables_meta.effect: Fraction of direct research USD paid by company under internal R&D (IRAD).
tunables_meta.rationale: IRAD is 100% self-funded out of company cash reserves, though unlock is proprietary.

tunables_meta.name: govt_contract_company_cost_share
tunables_meta.effect: Fraction of direct research USD paid by company when backed by USAF/USN/NACA contract.
tunables_meta.rationale: Government R&D contracts reimburse 80% of direct lab costs and boost speed via NACA/Wright Field data.

tunables_meta.name: govt_contract_speed_multiplier
tunables_meta.effect: Research speed multiplier when funded by a government research contract.
tunables_meta.rationale: Access to Wright Field / BuAer test data and government laboratories.

tunables_meta.name: naca_diffusion_lag_years
tunables_meta.effect: Years after historical_year before NACA Technical Notes begin diffusing a tech to all US firms.
tunables_meta.rationale: Models wartime/classified NACA RM reports declassifying into industry-wide NACA TN reports after ~2 years.

tunables_meta.name: naca_report_speed_multiplier
tunables_meta.effect: Speed bonus when actively researching a naca_diffusion=true node after its NACA diffusion date.
tunables_meta.rationale: Having NACA wind-tunnel reports in hand makes internal adoption much faster.

tunables_meta.name: naca_passive_drip_frac_per_day
tunables_meta.effect: Fraction of node total progress gained passively per day once NACA diffusion starts and prereqs are met.
tunables_meta.rationale: At 0.0012/day (~44%/yr), an unresearched NACA tech with met prereqs diffuses automatically in ~2.3 years.

tunables_meta.name: default_unlock_maturity
tunables_meta.effect: Initial maturity assigned to a newly unlocked tech if not overridden by node.initial_maturity.
tunables_meta.rationale: First unlock represents laboratory/conceptual proof; flight hardware still carries high uncertainty.

tunables_meta.name: passive_maturity_rate_per_day
tunables_meta.effect: Daily passive maturity growth for unlocked techs up to passive_maturity_cap.
tunables_meta.rationale: ~0.09/year passive refinement from ongoing bench work; reaching >0.65 requires building & flying aircraft.

tunables_meta.name: passive_maturity_cap
tunables_meta.effect: Maximum maturity reachable through passive time alone without flight test or production.
tunables_meta.rationale: You cannot mature an afterburner or swept wing to 0.95 on paper alone—you must test and build it.

tunables_meta.name: maturity_gain_tunnel_campaign
tunables_meta.effect: Base maturity gain (scaled by 1 - maturity) when a design using the tech completes a wind-tunnel campaign.
tunables_meta.rationale: Rewards wind-tunnel testing of novel aerodynamic/structural technologies.

tunables_meta.name: maturity_gain_first_flight
tunables_meta.effect: Base maturity gain (scaled by 1 - maturity) on first flight of a prototype using the tech.
tunables_meta.rationale: Building and flying a prototype is the biggest single learning milestone.

tunables_meta.name: maturity_gain_flaw_fixed
tunables_meta.effect: Base maturity gain (scaled by 1 - maturity) when a HiddenFlaw associated with the tech is diagnosed and fixed.
tunables_meta.rationale: Fixing transonic pitch-up or inlet buzz permanently teaches the engineering team how to avoid it.

tunables_meta.name: maturity_gain_production_10_units
tunables_meta.effect: Base maturity gain (scaled by 1 - maturity) per 10 production aircraft delivered using the tech.
tunables_meta.rationale: Series production and squadron service drive maturity toward 1.0.
